items.title: Backfill past seasons for users who join mid-dynasty
items.desc: DECISION PENDING (user parked it). Research is done: a save keeps almost no history — a 2029 preseason save retains 43 games (the 2028 postseason only) and nothing from 2026-27, so there is no automatic backfill to build. Career totals and league award history do survive, and the importer already backfills "history-only" seasons (champion, runner-up, conference champs, award winners). What a newcomer is missing is their OWN story: record, ranking, bowl result. Recommendation: (1) surface the old-save import path first — importing any older save file backfills that season completely, free; (2) season-LEVEL entry, ~8 fields, two minutes a season; (3) per-game results later (13 rows/season); (4) push back on full box scores — one season is ~1,300 stat rows, four is ~5,000, worse than the spreadsheet users came here to escape. Settle first: typed stats need marked provenance, must never be overwritten by a later sync, and need a story for records/leaderboards. Would be the first archive data with no save behind it.

items.title: User-editable neutral / championship venue overrides
items.desc: DECISION PENDING (user parked it). NOT needed for FBS conference championships or named bowls — those resolve already, on old imports too. It covers what the built-in tables cannot know: teambuilder and modded schools, custom conferences, a stadium EA renames mid-cycle, a championship moved in-game in a PAST season (only the extracted venue id captures a move, and old seasons have no id), and the 4 unnamed CFP ids. Infrastructure exists: StadiumDataProvider already has defaults + localStorage overrides + per-entry reset, and StadiumDatabaseMenu the UI — this is a second tab there, not new plumbing.

items.title: Name the 4 remaining CFP venue ids
items.desc: Four venue ids appear only on CFP quarterfinals/semifinals (plus one week-0 neutral opener) and are deliberately unmapped: those rounds carry a BLANK bowl AssetName, so nothing in the save identifies the venue, and a guess would render a wrong stadium with total confidence. They fall back to the honest "Neutral Site" badge. Resolving needs a save where those games land at a venue that also appears somewhere identifiable — the same cross-validation that confirmed Mercedes-Benz and Ford Field. One line each in lib/neutralVenues.ts.

items.title: CFP round graphics wash out on the light theme
items.desc: getPlayoffRoundImagePath returns a single asset with no light/dark variant, unlike the national-championship mark which has both. On a light page the first-round / quarterfinal / semifinal graphics sit pale against white. Pre-existing; affects the user's own schedule identically to a browsed team's. Spotted while verifying the bowl-logo work, not introduced by it.

items.title: Player development — program-wide Most Improved / Breakout leaders
items.desc: The per-player development chart already ships in the player modal (getPlayerDevelopment walks each season's leaguewide roster by PresentationId). What is still open from the original idea: program-wide Most Improved and Breakout leaderboards, and a recruiting-star vs final-overall view — i.e. the aggregate layer over the per-player curve that already exists.

items.title: All-Time Program Leaderboards
items.desc: The save's own record book exposes a single record per category. Every archived season's player stats are stored, so they can be aggregated into real top-10 career and single-season leaderboards for the main categories, each entry linking to the player. Note this is distinct from the National Stat Leaders page, which is current-season and leaguewide.

items.title: Modded-save support (year-shifted saves) — decision pending
items.desc: Root cause found and both fixes tested on copies: CurrentSeasonYear was moved (e.g. 2007) while BaseCalendarYear stayed at 2026, so the relative season index went negative and no games/stats imported. Testing showed a residual gap in the app-side index-only fix (currentYearSummary matching), so the recommendation is to normalise the BASE year rather than the index. Chosen direction was to ask the mod author to shift BaseCalendarYear by the same delta — decision still open on whether to also handle it app-side.

items.title: School record book chase (Yearly analytics)
items.desc: Surface how close current players are to the program's own record book entries — an active chase rather than a static list.

items.title: Resume & quality wins per season (Yearly analytics)
items.desc: VERIFIED PRESENT and entirely unused by analytics: the game_context table already holds 3,627 rows of opponent AP/CFP rank and W-L captured at kickoff, per game. Per season that yields wins over ranked opponents, best win, worst loss, and a real strength of schedule from opponents' records. No extraction change needed.

items.title: School record book has no opponent/score context (save limitation)
items.desc: STILL TRUE, unlike the other three limitation entries. The save's single-game record table carries only player/position/year/value — no opponent, week or final score to join against, so a record entry can never say who it came against. Listed as research in case another table turns out to carry it.
